name: Jianhua Lin
bio: Jianhua attended the NSF High School Research Program in Genetics at the AMNH for two academic years (2005-2007). She learned to conduct measurements and record setal counts under the supervision of Jeremy Huff and Lorenzo Prendini (summer 2006). From fall 2006 she worked in the Molecular Systematics Laboratory extracting, amplifying, and sequencing scorpion DNA.
